title: AI News Monitoring
searchIntent: grok bot to track ai news
intro: Keeping up with AI is a job people hand to a bot early, partly because the volume is genuinely unmanageable and partly because it is the first thing anyone thinks to try. The listings split between feed readers that summarise a fixed set of sources and bots that watch X for whatever is being discussed. The second is more current and considerably noisier, since engagement and importance are not the same signal. What makes one of these worth keeping is a threshold. A bot that reports every model release produces a newsletter you stop opening; a bot that reports only when something changes a decision you have already made is useful indefinitely. Few templates set that up for you, so expect to spend an evening telling it what you do not care about, which is the part that actually determines whether you keep it.

bots.fitReason: Watches official release channels from xAI, Anthropic, Google, OpenAI, DeepSeek, Moonshot, Alibaba and others on a fixed 07:30 run — exactly the job, and it stays quiet when there is nothing. Caveat: official announcements only, so the discourse and the noise around them pass it by.
Briefs AI, startups, funding and founder moves off the RuntimeWire feed for operators. A single-source wire rather than a broad sweep, so what it misses is whatever RuntimeWire misses.

Learns your beat from your recent posts, then sends one weekday end-of-day brief on what your corner of X actually said. The X flavour of this job, so expect engagement-weighted noise until you have told it what you do not care about.

Samples your X feed through the day and clusters it into a 7am brief, read-only. Genuinely reduces scrolling, but it monitors whatever you already follow rather than AI specifically — the filtering is your job.

Gathers overnight tech news into a short pre-work briefing, aimed at writers and editors. Tech generally rather than AI narrowly, and it bundles in your actionable email whether you wanted that or not.

Mines the hottest AI stories of the last 24 hours across web, X and Instagram and ranks them. Built as the front of a content pipeline — the output is a briefing for a copywriter bot, not a reader's digest, and it works in Portuguese.
Transcript-based morning recap of channels you nominate, silent when nothing new drops — a workable AI-news reader if you pick AI channels. Nothing about it is AI-specific, and it sees only YouTube.
